newsitem.title: GERMANY: Full text of latest Buba statement on reserves.
newsitem.headline: Full text of latest Buba statement on reserves.

text.p: Following is the text of the Bundesbank's latest statement concerning the planned revaluation of reserves. The text has been translated into English by Reuters.

"President Dr Tietmeyer and Vice President Gaddum today reported to the central bank council about the talks held in the last two weeks with the Federal Finance Minister about questions regarding the future accounting method of the German Bundesbank.
The central bank council welcomed efforts to find a mutually acceptable resolution to these questions and the agreement on the central points reached in the talks held so far.
Based on the results of talks so far the central bank council sees good prospects for a solution which takes account of the fundamental position it outlined in its statement on May 28.

The central bank council asked its President and Vice President to continue the talks with the Federal Finance Minister with the aim of soon reaching a mutually acceptable clarification of details of the solution being sought."
